findings.evidence: In the end frame, the hand overlaps the “Approve” label, partially obscuring the decision control.
findings.suggestion: Move the hand slightly below or beside the button so its gesture remains associated with approval while the full label stays readable.

findings.evidence: The end frame’s “Ask owner” card has an alert icon and placeholder lines, but no explicit indication that it represents missing information; no unresolved tray is visible.
findings.suggestion: Label the card “Missing information” above “Ask owner” to distinguish the unresolved-information route from the approval and editing controls.
